identificationModule.briefTitle: SKB264 Monotherapy in Selected Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Open-label, Phase 2 Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of SKB264 Monotherapy in Selected Subjects With Advanced Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety and efficacy of SKB264 monotherapy in subjects with selected advanced solid tumors.The study is divided into two parts: the Part Ⅰ consists of 5 cohorts, and the Part Ⅱ for expansion. Eligible subjects will receive SKB264 monotherapy, until there is no longer clinical benefit, intolerable toxicity, discontinuation of study treatment required by the subject, or other protocol-specified treatment discontinuation criteria, whichever occurs first.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The second part of this study is a randomized, open-label, multicenter Phase 2 clinical study of SKB264 monotherapy versus docetaxel in subjects with locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC.

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the proportion of subjects with confirmed complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) as the best overall response assessed per RECIST 1.1.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline until disease progression, death, or other protocol defined reason, up to approximately 21 months.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs)
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs) graded by Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) v5.0.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From subject sign the informed consent form (ICF) to 30 days after the last dose of study treatment.

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as the time from the first dose to progressive disease (PD) or death, whichever occurs first. PD will be assessed per RECIST 1.1.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline until disease progression, death, or other protocol defined reason,up to approximately 21 months.

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR is defined as the time from the date of first documented CR or PR to PD or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline until disease progression, death, or other protocol defined reason, up to approximately 21 months.

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR is defined as the proportion of subjects with CR, PR or stable disease (SD) as the best overall response assessed per RECIST 1.1.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline until disease progression, death, or other protocol defined reason, up to approximately 21 months.

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS is defined as the time period from the start of administration to death due to any cause.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline until death due to any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Presence of Anti-drug antibodys (ADAs) for SKB264.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From baseline up to 12 months after last patient enrollment.
